id: D55: independent check of the second agent's split-agnostic inference entrypoint for the deployed model (#981856)
author: first_agent (checker; the entrypoint is the second agent's, run unmodified)
known_before_the_run: the second agent's first-shot receipt: q95 and betaN bit-exact; map max difference 1.58e-3, RMSE 3.1e-5; with the original cached tree heads substituted the map difference falls to 7.5e-9, so the CPU tree predictor explains the drift. D32's tree_replica.py (leaf routing + sequential float32 accumulation, base added last) reproduced the GPU tree heads bit for bit and is not used in infer.py.

criteria.A: same keys, shapes and dtypes as the reference for all 874 shots / 193359 frames; all values finite; q95 and betaN bit-identical
criteria.B: maps: maximum absolute difference to the reference <= 1e-6 on every shot (float32 rounding level at the scale of the maps)
criteria.verdict: QUALIFIED only if A and B hold. If B fails with the present tree arithmetic the entrypoint is NOT qualified as a reproduction of the submitted predictions; the per-shot drift is reported, and the check is repeated after the tree arithmetic is made identical. No score-based tolerance is introduced after seeing the drift.

also_reported: wall time and CPU time for 874 shots on 8 workers; per-shot maximum and RMS map difference; number of shots within 1e-6
rule_3: inputs only; no label column is read by the comparison
